scrutiny.test: T0 purpose: honest labels are what make prismis's summaries trustworthy to agents; misfiring on Simon Willison release notes hides high-signal content, and letting link-only posts through presents comment chatter as article analysis. Code for structural facts, model for judgment, advances both.
scrutiny.failureCase: The change traded one mislabel class for another without measurement.

scrutiny.test: T1 owners: boundaries.md:56 (shape-based readability, placeholder text defined once and imported by the writer) is met by moving the discussion header into readability.py and judging link posts by shape.
scrutiny.failureCase: A rule were added as a second copy of a shape the fetcher also defines.

scrutiny.test: T2/T5 evidence on the same noun: the wording was chosen on real stored cerebro items run through the deployed summarizer call with only the paragraph replaced (substantive_probe3.json); the code rules were replayed over 45 days of real Reddit content.
scrutiny.failureCase: The wording or rules were chosen on invented examples.

scrutiny.test: T3 degrades: three hard junk items stay readable (status quo before the verdict); link posts without articles become title-only even with long threads; reddit-internal link posts (galleries, crossposts), now title-only, are re-read each fetch cycle while in the discovery window although no article can come (about 4 in 3 days on cerebro).

T7 consumers of the new reason, enumerated with `grep -rn 'is_readable(\|readability_failure(' daemon/src`: analysis.py title_only_reason, orchestrator readmit, storage refetch selection, refetch.py, fetchers/rss.py and fetchers/reddit.py extraction acceptance; for link posts only the reason helper and readmit/selection change behavior, all intended.
scrutiny.failureCase: A consumer started rejecting article text because of the new rule.

scrutiny.test: T11 class: link plus comments was the unhandled sibling of the existing bare-link placeholder check, and a markdown link the sibling of the bare-URL stripping; both siblings are handled together.
scrutiny.failureCase: Only the reported instances were patched.

scrutiny.test: T10 undo: revert the commit; no stored data changes beyond the three re-analysed items.

carried: Reddit link posts to reddit-internal targets (galleries, crossposts) are title-only and re-read each fetch cycle while in the discovery window, though no article can come.
